and it gives the power of prophecy, and the interpretation of all dreams, and makes one understand enigmas.

¶ If you wish to have a good understanding in the senses, and to be unable to become drunk: take the stone which is called **Amethyst** <note>original: "Amatistus"</note>; and it is of a purple color, and the best is born in India, and it is effective against drunkenness. And it confers a good understanding in knowable things.

<margin>+</margin>
¶ If you wish to overcome enemies and put an end to lawsuits: take the stone which is called **Beryl** <note>original: "Berillus"</note>; and it is of a pale color, with light as transparent as water. Carry it with you and you will win all lawsuits and put enemies to flight; and it will make an enemy mild. It renders power effective in one's conduct, just as Aaron says. It also gives a good understanding in knowable things.

¶ If you wish to divine concerning the future: take the stone which is called **Chelonite** <note>original: "Chelonytes"; a stone traditionally said to be found in the head of a tortoise</note>; and it is of various purple colors, and is found in the body of a tortoise. If anyone indeed carries this stone under the tongue, he will divine and predict future things. Nevertheless, it does not have power unless the first moon has been lit <note>referring to the new moon</note>, and the rising moon is in its final descent. So wishes Aaron <note>referring to the legendary authority on stones and herbs</note> regarding the powers of stones and herbs.

<margin>+</margin>
¶ If you wish to pacify storms and cross rivers: take the stone which is called **Coral** <note>original: "Corallus"</note> and it is red, while another kind is white. And it has been proven that it immediately stanches blood, and when carried, it drives away foolishness and provides wisdom. And this has been proven by some in our own time; and it is effective against storms and the dangers of rivers.

<summary>This page details the magical properties of Amethyst, Beryl, Chelonite, and Coral, focusing on their abilities to prevent drunkenness, win legal disputes, predict the future, and provide protection during travel.</summary>
